violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Impossible, breakfast sandwich, impossible breakfast sandwich, egg and pesto sandwich in unit # 9 at 43, 43,43F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded Impossible, breakfast sandwich, impossible breakfast sandwich, egg and pesto sandwich.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM found the active the HD food establishment permit and posted it in plain sight for compliance.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: the dishes in the high temperature dish machine were not properly being sanitized because the dishes machine was not reaching the appropriate internal temperature.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM removed the dishes from the machine and placed in the 3 vat sink for rewashing , rinsing and sanitizing. The dish machine was taken out of commission until a work order and repairs can be placed.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the high temperature dish machine registered at 152F
violations.corrective_action: The CFM removed the dishes from the machine and placed them in the 3 vat sink for rewashing , rinsing and sanitizing. The dish machine was taken out of commission until a work order and repairs can be placed. The 3 vat sink will be used.
